llm_metadata.reasoning: Rebuilt DlBlerModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor, targeting physical constraints of BLER (clipping predictions strictly between 0.0 and 1.0) and leveraging key telemetry lag/rolling features alongside radio parameters (MCS, CQI, SNR, TBS, RBs) to capture transient block error behaviors under varying channel conditions.

Rebuilt UlBlerModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor trained on domain-specific uplink features (UL BLER lags, PUSCH SNR, UL MCS, PHR, UL PRBs, and UL throughput). Output predictions are clipped to valid BLER bounds [0.0, 1.0]. Implement standard DTComponent interface with zero-argument default instantiation.

Rebuilt the DlPrbModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor with non-negativity clipping to better handle non-linear relationships and interactions between lagged PRB counts, throughput, transport block sizes, and CQI metrics.

Rebuilt UlThroughputModel component directly extending DTComponent using HistGradientBoostingRegressor. Selected core uplift/channel features (PUSCH SNR, BSR, PHR, UL MCS, lag/rolling metrics) and added fallback feature alignment for predicted vs actual upstream KPI columns to prevent key errors during inference.

Rebuilt DlRlcDelayModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor to better capture non-linear interactions and delay spikes in zero-inflated RLC delay target distributions. Incorporates relevant lagged RAN features along with upstream dependency predictions (dl_throughput, dl_bler).
